Fact check: Every single part of this Trump story about South Korea is wrong
Evidence: historical cost-sharing, fabricated $3B claim, false Biden blame #Aletheia #USPol #Geopolitics

Donald Trump claimed South Korea paid nothing for U.S. troops until he demanded $3 billion per year, and that Joe Biden subsequently rescinded the arrangement.
